PCSX2 SQRT_S reads _Ft_ (bits 20-16), not _Fs_. Opcode table: sqrt.s fmt=S, source ft, bits 15-11 = 0, func=4. ABS/MOV/NEG keep source in fs.

Translator emits the MIPS source: fpu_translator.cpp:61 FPU_SQRT_S(ctx->f[fs]). RSQRT at line 80 correctly uses fs/sqrt(ft). makeCop1S(fn,fd,fs,ft) test at ps2_float_semantics_tests.cpp:223 covers RSQRT only.
0x18e2d4 word 0x46010044 is the same encoding (ft=1 fs=0 fd=1). Preceding madd.s leaves the length in f1 and the z component in f0. Cpp comment is c1, and the body sqrts f0.
